spec.description:
Bradford Supertel Plain is a high-density (32kg/m3) unfaced
glasswool insulation blanket and board engineered for high-performance thermal
and acoustic applications. Manufactured by spinning molten glass containing up
to 65% recycled content into fine bio-soluble fibres bonded with a thermosetting
resin, Supertel Plain delivers high thermal resistance and acoustic absorption
at minimal thickness. It is widely used in commercial HVAC ductwork, acoustic
attenuators, plant room enclosures, and behind perforated architectural wall or
ceiling linings.
features:

Unfaced (plain) format

Non-combustible bulk insulation complying with AS 1530.1

properties (0/0/0/0-1) to AS/NZS 1530.3

Continuous maximum service
temperature up to 350°C (unfaced)

Acoustic absorption rating (NRC) up to 0.85

Manufactured using safe FBS-1 bio-soluble
glasswool formulation

Zero
Ozone Depleting Potential (ODP) and low VOC emissions

Available in
thicknesses from 13mm to 100mm in both blanket rolls and semi-rigid boards

install:
Ensure installation substrate (duct, framing cavity, or enclosure)
is clean and dry

Cut Supertel Plain blanket or board to required size using a
sharp insulation knife

Impale over welded insulation pins on sheet metal, or
friction-fit into framed cavities

Secure with speed clips or retaining
washers
Butt edges tightly to eliminate acoustic and thermal leaks

If
installed behind perforated panels, ensure face is covered or contained to
prevent air-stream fibre loss
selection_checklist:
Select thickness (13mm to 100mm) based
on thermal R-value or NRC target

Confirm unfaced format is appropriate (e.g.
for concealed cavities or custom lamination)
Specify insulation stick pins, speed clips, and fasteners
accessories: Insulation stick pins and speed clips
limitations:
Unfaced format does not provide vapour barrier
protection against condensation

Not for direct exposure to high-velocity air
streams without facing or scrim
Keep dry during storage and installation

splitter and attenuator fabrication

Thermal and acoustic insulation in
commercial industrial equipment enclosures operating up to 350°C
not_for: Exposed residential ceiling attic batts without covering

Moisture-prone
applications requiring a vapour barrier

High-velocity open air streams
without protective scrim or facing
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Supertel Plain
is an unfaced, 32 kg/m3 high-density bio-soluble glasswool blanket and board
engineered for superior thermal and acoustic performance. With a continuous
service temperature limit of 350°C and AS 1530.1 non-combustibility, it achieves
exceptional sound absorption (NRC 0.85 to 1.10) and thermal resistance from R0.4
to R3.0 (13mm to 100mm). Widely specified as acoustic infill behind perforated
architectural panelling, in HVAC attenuators, and for industrial enclosures, it
offers versatile, non-combustible sound and heat dampening.
